settings.question: Learn more what makes a great video!
settings.answer:
Thank you for sharing your experience. Please take a look at these video shared by customers:

You'll notice in these videos:

  1. Good lighting
  2. Video quality is stable (the phone is on a tripod or on something stable)
  3. Clear close up of how their teeth looked before, how they put on their Pop On Veneers, and how they look with their Pop On Veneers on
  4. They share their story, why they choose Pop On Veneers (sometimes showing other solutions they may have tried, other options they considered from dentist or other companies
  5. They show an unboxing including the 3D teeth molds of what your teeth look like, the blue mirror case twitch the veneers
  6. They have great energy on camera as they share their story in the most genuine way that feels right for them. There is not right or wrong way to tell your story, it's your story, use the tone that feels right to you!
  7. Take your time, share as much as you want to describe your experience!
